remarks: Awesome 1 BR/1BTH 7th floor located front and center in downtown Stamford at Bedford Towers. You can't get any closer to the city's biggest and best eat street -- Bedford Street and its concentration of bars, restaurants and nightlife, the scene of your dreams. This 770 sq/ft high floor unit sits just beyond scenester city and faces directly out to Latham Park, right past the cherished Avon Theater with a big balcony to slay those views for days. Where else can one get a front row seat to an endless supply of annual city events. activities, top shelf restaurants and the one and only modernist Landmark Building, once the tallest building in Stamford. Commuting is a breeze with public transportation, Metro North, Amtrak and all major travel arteries close by. Stamford mall, Ferguson Library, movie theaters, UCONN, all close by. The unit features a combined dining and living room, spacious bedroom, cute little kitchen and classic parquet wood floors that bring out the unit's history and vintage beauty. Extra storage, one parking space, heat, hot water and cooking gas included in your rent! Secured bldg. card-op laundry, beautiful large lobby with a stunning modern atrium. Showing time after 11:00 am
